section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Politically exposed person risks

propositions.proposition: 识别政治敏感人物的挑战在于各司法管辖区的指引和建议不同
source_quotes: One challenge in identifying PEPs is the varying guidance and recommendations in each jurisdiction.

propositions.proposition: 在识别政治敏感人物时，机构必须遵守当地监管要求
source_quotes: Organizations must adhere to their local regulatory requirements in identifying PEPs.

propositions.proposition: 机构可根据其风险偏好选择执行更高的政治敏感人物标准
source_quotes: organizations may choose to enforce higher standards based on their risk appetite.

propositions.proposition: 高层职位个人及其关联人更易受腐败影响
source_quotes: Individuals in high positions and their associates are more vulnerable to corruption.

propositions.proposition: 在界定政治敏感人物时，应采用宽泛定义
source_quotes: Use a broad definition for defining a PEP.

propositions.proposition: 由于政治敏感人物经常使用名义人或关联企业，因此政治敏感人物的定义还应包括其直系亲属、密切关联人以及他们拥有或控制的企业
source_quotes: PEPs will often use nominees or businesses they are associated with.
Therefore, the definition of PEP can also include:
Businesses owned or held by those individuals

propositions.proposition: 基于风险的方法下，政治敏感人物风险是可控的
source_quotes: Under a risk-based approach, PEP risk is manageable.

propositions.proposition: 部分机构采用“一旦是政治敏感人物，永远是政治敏感人物”的方法，因为个体在下台后可能仍保持在同样的势力圈内
source_quotes: Some organizations follow a "once a PEP, always a PEP" approach because the individual may remain in the same circles of influence, even if they have stepped down.

propositions.proposition: 机构在评估政治敏感人物风险时，可考察个体当时的影响力（如授予合同或分配资金的能力）以及被归类为政治敏感人物的时间长短
source_quotes: The individual’s influence at the time, such as their ability to award contracts or allocate funds
How long the individual has been classified as a PEP

propositions.proposition: 机构必须根据其风险偏好采取必要步骤调整交易监控和了解你的客户审查，并在必要时进行升级
source_quotes: Organizations must take the necessary steps to adapt transaction monitoring and KYC reviews and escalate based on their risk appetite.
